title: Clear Ores
description: Makes Ores easier to find by adding Outlines to their textures.
body:
**Clear Ores** is a simple texture pack that makes ores easier to recognize at a glance by adding clean, visible borders around each ore texture.

## Features:

- Adds clear borders to ore blocks
- Makes ores easier to distinguish while mining
- Keeps a simple, vanilla-friendly style
- Great for caves, strip mining and low-light areas
- Lightweight resource pack with no gameplay changes
